title: v6 reference responses, one per interpretation
description: What the replying speaker would naturally say if they held each reading of the vocalization. One response per interpretation, written from the reading alone — never from the response guide, so that scoring these against the guides measures fit rather than recall. These are the probes the separability measurement cross-scores: a response written under one condition's reading is scored under both conditions, and the item separates if responses lean toward the condition they came from.

text.description: spoken reply, one to three sentences, no stage directions

note.description: what in this reading the reply is answering
